items.reason: This is the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash you asked for, a rinse-off option for jawline breakouts.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable while the wash is new, and your moisture score is mid-range.
A mineral SPF 50 each morning helps protect skin and keeps marks from looking darker in the sun.

response.routine_note: Start with the wash once a day or every other day on damp skin for 1 to 2 minutes, rinse well, then moisturize, and use sunscreen every morning; it can bleach towels and fabrics. If skin feels dry or stinging, cut back, and if breakouts are painful, deep, scarring or don't improve in about 8 weeks, a dermatologist is the better next step.
